# Maya's superobjectives

Up to three, ranked: the first leads when they compete. Twelve months out, audacious, and theirs. Pluma sizes every move against them and ranks the superprojects that climb toward the first one first. They are calibrated monthly and never graded: ahead of pace, one is raised; behind pace, none is lowered quietly. An area only to maintain is a recurrent, not a superobjective.

## Superobjective 1

**My book of garden designs in print by October 18, 2027, with a month in Japan.**

by: 2027-10-18

### In their words (2026-10-18)

Maya: "Finally start the book." Then, when Pluma asked what would scare her a little: "In print. A real one. And I research it in Kyoto, not from photos."

### What would be true

1. A printed proof of the book on my kitchen table.
2. A publisher has signed the book.
3. Twelve gardens photographed in all four seasons.
4. A month in Kyoto booked and paid for.

## Superobjective 2

**I run the Fernhill half marathon in under two hours on April 25, 2027.**

by: 2027-04-25

### What would be true

Not written yet: three to five signs anyone could see, so the climb can be checked.
